hardware.identity: ROM chip and MAC checked before writing; distinct MACs required in combined analysis
hardware.numerical_panel: unchanged recovery040 panel: 26 configurations x 1024 inputs
hardware.analysis: separate by board; compare with S3 O2 A-to-B cells; no pooled universal speedup

external_data.source_selection: 12 CSV shards with smallest SHA256 of UTF8('ids056-source-v1:' + file_name), from complete pinned mirror catalog; selection does not use labels or predictions
external_data.contract: original CSV columns in this exact order and their original units; finite nonnegative float32, signed zero canonicalized; no substitution for TON features
external_data.features_selected_by: fixed descriptive timing/size/rate subset before fitting; no score-based feature search
external_data.label_rule: exact BenignTraffic is normal; 33 explicitly enumerated attack labels are attack; unknown labels stop execution
external_data.split: SHA256(UTF8('ids056-role-v1:') + eight little-endian float32 values); first 8 bytes interpreted little endian modulo 100
external_data.B_fit: union of A_fit and B_fit_added; both calibration roles excluded
external_data.independence_boundary: identical admitted feature vectors stay in one atomic role; capture/session independence is not established
external_data.models: unchanged 030 fitting algorithms and hyperparameters; new CIC-specific feature names and independently fitted A/B parameters
external_data.normal_calibration: all admitted normal rows in each calibration role
external_data.test: all admitted common-test rows in selected shards; row, equal-vector and capped-frequency-100 weighting; per-attack-type counts
external_data.outputs: all complete A/B pipelines and fixed component/export variants, including unfavorable and undefined outcomes
external_data.scope: independent-dataset controlled release-update experiment; not chronological drift, TON-to-CIC detector transfer, or full-corpus CIC benchmark
